name: Visualising in the Mirror the Man I Want to Become (Terry Davis)
aliases: visualising in the mirror the man i want to become
the man i want to become
description: A painting of a man looking into a mirror, with a clip of Terry Davis dancing in a TempleOS t-shirt playing inside the mirror, captioned "visualising in the mirror the man i want to become:". Music, no speech.
usage: Aspirations: the carefree, self-made, unbothered person you want to be.
